title: कबीर के दोहे
note: Stand-in sample (Kabir's dohas are centuries old and in the public domain). Transliteration and translation are my own. Replace with your own songs.

lines.original: बुरा जो देखन मैं चला, बुरा न मिलिया कोय।
lines.transliteration: Bura jo dekhan main chala, bura na miliya koy.
lines.translation: I set out to look for the wicked, and found no wicked person.

lines.original: जो दिल खोजा आपना, मुझसे बुरा न कोय॥
lines.transliteration: Jo dil khoja aapna, mujhse bura na koy.
lines.translation: When I searched my own heart, no one was worse than me.

lines.original: दुख में सुमिरन सब करें, सुख में करे न कोय।
lines.transliteration: Dukh mein sumiran sab karein, sukh mein kare na koy.
lines.translation: In sorrow everyone remembers God; in happiness no one does.

lines.original: जो सुख में सुमिरन करे, तो दुख काहे को होय॥
lines.transliteration: Jo sukh mein sumiran kare, to dukh kaahe ko hoy.
lines.translation: If one remembered Him in happiness, why would sorrow ever come?

lines.original: माटी कहे कुम्हार से, तू क्या रौंदे मोय।
lines.transliteration: Maati kahe kumhaar se, tu kya raunde moy.
lines.translation: The clay says to the potter: why do you trample me?

lines.original: एक दिन ऐसा आएगा, मैं रौंदूँगी तोय॥
lines.transliteration: Ek din aisa aayega, main raundungi toy.
lines.translation: A day will come when I will trample you.
